verified_apis.observable_result: simplexml_load_string returns the root SimpleXMLElement over a libxml2 tree; walking it with SimpleXML methods only (xpath('*') and xpath('@*') for document order, getNamespaces(false) with a self::*[namespace-uri()] check for the element namespace, getDocNamespaces(false, false) for each element's own declarations, string casts for text) gives a prefixed root {urn:parsarium:catalog}catalog with a default-namespace child scope, 5 elements in Clark notation, 2 namespace declarations, a prefixed attribute {urn:parsarium:catalog}lang, entity-decoded text and CDATA text, depth 3; the second control gives 7 elements, 3 declarations including the xmlns="" undeclaration, char-reference-decoded text and depth 4
verified_apis.observable_limits: SimpleXML exposes no text-node or comment/PI accessor: (string) of an element concatenates its direct text and CDATA, so character-data runs split by child elements, comments or PIs inside one element are merged and ordered before the element's children. Comments, PIs and the XML declaration are not exposed. Element namespace URIs and document-order children/attributes come from SimpleXMLElement::xpath. Neither control has non-whitespace mixed content, so the summary equals the expat oracle on both.
verified_apis.family_note: Same parser family as the XMLReader::XML and DOMDocument::loadXML entries: ext/simplexml hands the string to libxml2 (xmlReadMemory with the SAX2 tree builder) and wraps the root element. It is a third standard API over the same engine, not an independent parser.

verified_apis.runtime: PHP 8.5.12 CLI (source build, --disable-all --with-libxml --enable-xml) with source-built libxml2 2.15.4
verified_apis.api: xml_parser_create_ns(?string $encoding = null, string $separator = ":"): XMLParser; xml_parse(XMLParser $parser, string $data, bool $is_final = false): int
verified_apis.input: in-memory bytes passed to xml_parse in one call with is_final=true on a parser from xml_parser_create_ns('UTF-8', "\x01"); no file or URL input, and no other parser sees the bytes
verified_apis.observable_result: xml_parse drives libxml2's push parser through ext/xml/compat.c and calls the PHP event handlers; with case folding off and the "\x01" separator, the start-element, end-element, start-namespace-declaration, character-data, PI and default (comment) handlers give a prefixed root {urn:parsarium:catalog}catalog with a default-namespace child scope, 5 elements in Clark notation, 2 namespace declarations, a prefixed attribute {urn:parsarium:catalog}lang, entity-decoded text and CDATA text, depth 3; the second control gives 7 elements, 3 declarations including the xmlns="" undeclaration, char-reference-decoded text and depth 4
verified_apis.observable_limits: Event-handler summary from ext/xml with case folding off (ext/xml folds case by default, and then upper-cases the whole expanded name, namespace URI included) and the separator "\x01" (not an RFC 3986 URI character and not an XML 1.0 Char, so it cannot occur in a well-formed XML 1.0 namespace or local name; ext/xml only uses the first separator byte). Character data and CDATA share the character data handler, so CDATA boundaries are not distinguished; text runs are flushed at element starts/ends, PIs and comments as in the expat oracle. ext/xml has no comment handler: comments reach the default handler as "<!--...-->" and only mark a text boundary. Any other default-handler data (an unexpanded user-defined entity reference, which needs a DTD) makes the harness fail rather than summarize it. ext/xml sets XML_PARSE_OLDSAX|XML_PARSE_NOENT on the libxml2 push parser and transcodes output to UTF-8. The controls are fed in one final xml_parse chunk; chunked feeding, the XML declaration (not reported) and xml_parse_into_struct are not exercised.
verified_apis.family_note: Same parser engine as the XMLReader::XML, DOMDocument::loadXML and simplexml_load_string entries, but a different libxml2 entry point: ext/xml (built without --with-expat) creates a push parser with xmlCreatePushParserCtxt and feeds xml_parse data through xmlParseChunk, with ext/xml/compat.c's expat-style SAX callbacks instead of the SAX2 tree builder. It is a fourth standard API over the same engine, not an independent parser.

limit: Two small UTF-8 namespace-aware controls without DOCTYPE verify XMLReader::XML, DOMDocument::loadXML, simplexml_load_string and xml_parser_create_ns/xml_parse for this PHP 8.5.12/libxml2 2.15.4 build; they do not establish DTD, external entity, non-UTF-8 encoding, XML 1.1, validation, DOMDocument::load()/simplexml_load_file() file-input behaviour, or chunked xml_parse feeding.
runtime_note: Each verified API has its own PHP 8.5.12 source build: XMLReader with --enable-xmlreader, DOMDocument with --enable-dom, SimpleXML with --enable-simplexml, XML Parser with --enable-xml (libxml2 compat layer, no --with-expat); all link the same source-built libxml2 2.15.4.
